items: Most one-star reviews point to fixable operational problems such as long waits, wrong orders, untrained staff or guests feeling ignored, so treat them as patterns to solve.
Guests expect acknowledgment more than perfection, and a slow or missing reply is often what keeps a negative review negative.
Audit your ratings and response times across every location, group complaints by theme, and give local managers a personal, brand-approved way to reply quickly.
Use AI to detect tone, suggest replies and route urgent reviews, then reach out to the guest directly in serious cases to close the loop offline.
